message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after an earlier missile exchange by executing a hard right turn and then extending east, nearly perpendicular to the closing opponents; its own missile is already northbound while opposing missiles advance south, and the maneuver creates lateral separation while preserving speed.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to sustain pressure before reducing exposure: it initially drives north behind its northbound missile while descending and accelerating, then shifts into a hard right, still-descending turn as opposing missiles close, creating lateral separation without immediately abandoning forward closure."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after an earlier missile exchange by executing a hard right turn and then extending east, nearly perpendicular to the closing opponents; its own missile is already northbound while opposing missiles advance south, and the maneuver creates lateral separation while preserving speed.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to sustain pressure before reducing exposure: it initially drives north behind its northbound missile while descending and accelerating, then shifts into a hard right, still-descending turn as opposing missiles close, creating lateral separation without immediately abandoning forward closure.
